## Overview

Z.ai Coding Plan provides model access for sandbox profiles that use OpenCode-compatible agent runtimes.

Use this connection when a profile should call Z.ai Coding Plan models through an API key managed by Mistle.

## Connect In Mistle

Open **Integrations** in the dashboard, choose **Z.ai Coding Plan**, then select **API key**.

Enter:

| Field   | Value                    |
| ------- | ------------------------ |
| API key | Z.ai Coding Plan API key |

## Use With A Sandbox Profile

After the connection exists:

1. Open the sandbox profile that should use Z.ai Coding Plan.
2. Add Z.ai Coding Plan as a model provider connection.
3. Save and publish the profile version.
